summary: Add the AI connectors of automation graphs: pkg/automation/connectors/openai (kind openai, node ai.llm: text or JSON checked against a JSON Schema, images for models with vision) and pkg/automation/connectors/jev (kind jev, node ai.jev: a classifier with an outcome per choice, low_confidence and failed; provider openrouter or openai). Both run on a tenant's key or on the platform key (automation.openai.* and automation.jev.* in the new stdconfig packages openaiconfig and jevconfig; opt_in per tenant), are idempotent, record every provider answer as token_in/token_out usage, write the model into the version when a graph is saved (exact ids only: aliases such as latest and rolling OpenAI ids without a date are refused) and cache decisions of dry runs. catalog.CompletedNode and catalog.ConnectionNode lets a node type complete and check its params on save knowing the connection it resolves to (View.UnavailableRequires keeps a node working with its connector kind when the tenant lost the connection), catalog.CallError gets RetryAfter, the engine reads timeout_ms as a call deadline, catalog.View gets PlatformWithheld, engine.TestNodeResult gets Request, graph.Issue gets an optional Code, graph.NodeSpec.OutputFrom.Field types one output field from a schema param, engine.Config gets an optional Connectors directory so only x-secret credential fields are masked, a call that names a switched-off platform key ends with unavailable, and the decision cache of dry runs now stores the output of a decision.
